about_the_game:
⚠️ IMPORTANT: Anaglyph Glasses Required 🔴🔵

BiColor Vision Trainer is designed to be used only with anaglyph glasses (red–blue or red–green).

Without anaglyph glasses, the vision training will not function correctly.

🔵 BiColor Vision Trainer – Game-Based Vision Therapy for Lazy Eye

BiColor Vision Trainer is a game-based application created to support lazy eye therapy through structured visual training at home.
It is designed for both lazy eye in children and lazy eye in adults, focusing on binocular vision, eye coordination, and balanced visual processing.

The app offers interactive lazy eye exercises at home, helping users stay consistent with training in a familiar and comfortable environment.
BiColor can be used as a complementary tool alongside vision therapy for lazy eye recommended by an eye care professional.

🧠 What Is BiColor?

BiColor transforms traditional lazy eye exercises into short, engaging mini-games.
Instead of repetitive clinical tasks, users train visual coordination through interactive gameplay while wearing anaglyph glasses.

Each eye receives a separate visual signal, encouraging the brain to combine both inputs more effectively.
This approach is commonly used in lazy eye treatment, binocular vision training, and modern amblyopia rehabilitation.

BiColor is suitable for:

  • Lazy eye games for kids and family-guided practice

  • Home-based support for amblyopia in children

  • Visual training for adults exploring whether improvement is still possible later in life

Many users ask questions like can games help lazy eye or does vision therapy work for lazy eye.
BiColor is designed around these game-based training principles.

🔴🔵 How Anaglyph Glasses Work

Anaglyph glasses use color-filtered lenses:

  • One eye perceives red elements

  • The other eye perceives blue elements

BiColor displays game objects using color separation so that each eye sees a different image.
This encourages binocular fusion, eye teaming, and visual coordination — key elements of lazy eye therapy and adult amblyopia treatment.

🎮 Key Features

👁️‍🗨️ Dichoptic visual training with color separation

🕹️ Lazy eye computer games designed for coordination and attention

🎯 Adjustable difficulty for children and adults

📊 Session-based progress tracking

🏠 Designed for lazy eye exercises at home

🧠 Supports binocular vision and eye teaming

🔴🔵 Compatible with red–blue and red–green anaglyph glasses

🧸 Mini-Games Included

🎈 Balloons
Improves focus, visual tracking, and attention through ordered target selection.

🦆 Duck Runner
Enhances reaction time, spatial awareness, and binocular coordination.

🎨 Paint
Develops precision, fine motor control, and color perception through guided drawing tasks.

⚠️ Important Notes ⚠️

  • Anaglyph glasses are required (not included).

  • BiColor is not a medical device.

  • This application does not replace professional diagnosis or treatment.

  • Always consult an eye care specialist before starting or modifying vision therapy.
